answer: Each task nonce is derived from a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse, so agents must commit before its unpredictable value is known and reveal work bound to it afterward. A sybil swarm cannot precompute valid answers or accumulate reusable offline results; per-identity admission limits and verification constrain post-pulse grinding. The pulse acts as a shared inlet, turning each quill of submitted work with the tide of fresh randomness.
